plan.goal: In the GitHub repository file list, click the "benchmarks, (Directory)" link, then "results, (Directory)", then "complex-missions-v1, (Directory)", then the "RESULTS.md, (File)" link, until the rendered document titled "캐시·JEV·Luna·Astra — 복잡한 전체 업무 비교" is shown. Do not open any other folder, file, commit, branch or settings link.

actions.description: On the repository home page, open the benchmarks folder from the file list.
Inside the benchmarks folder, open the results folder.
Inside the results folder, open the complex-missions-v1 folder.
Inside the complex-missions-v1 folder, open the RESULTS.md file.
